entries.en: Use the giantsgall knife at the designated locations to obtain sap from the great trees.

entries.en: Deliver the pots of great tree sap to Maru.
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Now that we've got stables and water for the hippos, everythin's in place for them to thrive. 'Course, it falls on us to keep it all maintained so that they can live long and happy lives.
entries.fr: C'est une bonne chose d'avoir une étable et un bassin pour les hippopotames, mais il faut les entretenir régulièrement pour qu'ils tiennent le plus longtemps possible.
entries.ja:
厩舎や水場が出来て、ヒッポたちの居場所ができたのは、
嬉しいことだけど、定期的に点検して保守しないとね。
どうせなら、長持ちさせたいし……。

entries.en: That's where you an' this knife come in, ─I need you to head over to the grove of great trees west of Purusa an' scrape off some sap from their bark. Hackin' away at three or so should get you enough to keep repairs goin' for some time yet.

entries.en: When this sap hardens, water bounces off of it like a sword on a shield. I reckon fortifyin' the wadin' pool with it'll keep any troublesome leaks from springin' up. For a time, leastways.
entries.fr: Lorsque cette sève durcit, elle devient un véritable imperméabilisant naturel. Il n'y a rien de mieux pour empêcher les fuites d'eau du bassin.
entries.ja:
この樹液は、固まると天然の防水剤になるんだよね。
水場の水漏れを防ぐのには、必須な代物でさ……。

entries.en: You have to anticipate problems before they happen, else everythin' will break all at once. I'll keep makin' the rounds, and give you a shout should I need your capable hands again.
entries.fr: Je ferai le nécessaire en inspectant tout ça de plus près. Attends-toi à ce que je te contacte à nouveau en cas de besoin, d'accord ? J'espère que tu trouveras le temps de m'aider !
entries.ja:
しっかり点検して、保守整備しておくよ。
もしもまた必要になったら、声をかけさせてもらうから、
その時はよろしくー。
